Cryptographic Sequencer
The Cryptographic Sequencer (or Emag) can be used to hack or break open a variety of differnt machines. It usually causes adverse and dangerous behaviors.
Hackable objects
Use ctrl + f to quickly search the table.
Name Description Emag Effects
AirlockIt opens and closes.Emagging forces the airlock open and fries the electronics so it will no longer close. Emagging an airlock requires a special emag varient called a doorjack.
Automated Announcement SystemAn automated announcement system that handles minor announcements over the radio.If a new crew joins, a new head joins, or if a new tech node is unlocked the resulting announcement will be gibberish.
Bar signA bar sign which has not been initialized, somehow. Complain at a coder!Emagging the barsign unlocks access to all the illegal sign designs.
Big ManipulatorOperates different objects. Truly, a groundbreaking innovation...Emagging allows the big manipulator to pick up living mobs.
Wall ButtonA remote control switch.Emagging removes any access restrictions on the button, and will also emag any device inside the button.
ClockAn ultra-futuristic, sleek, advanced, next-gen normal digital clock that tells the time. Powered by bluespace. Despite supposedly being better in every way to classic clocks, it just doesn't feel the same. They just don't make them the way they used to...Emagging causes the clock to display random times.
Lipid extractorSafely and efficiently extracts excess fat from a subject.Emagging removes any access restrictions, and disables the automatic ejection threshold, so the lipid extractor can remove lethal amounts of fat.
Fire alarmPull this in case of emergency. Thus, keep pulling it forever.Emagging turns the alarm speaker off and disables access for robots.
Equipment reclaimer stationUsed to reclaim your items after you finish your sentence at the labor camp.Emagging shorts access restrictions, allowing anyone to steal or claim another prisoners gear.
Organ harvesterAn advanced machine used for harvesting organs and limbs from the deceased.Emagging disables the vital sensors, allowing harvesting from living people.
Limb growerIt grows new limbs using Synthflesh.Emagging unlocks dangerous limb designs, like synthetic arm blades.
Medical kioskA freestanding medical kiosk, which can provide a wide range of medical analysis for diagnosis.Emagging overloads the health sensors, causing the kiosk to diagnose incorrectly, and display gibberish.
PhotoboothA machine with some drapes and a camera, used to update security record photos. Requires Law Office access to use.Emagging overloads the camera bulb, causing the photobooth to flash users.
Portable Gravity UnitGenerates gravity around itself. Powered by wire or cell. Must be anchored before use.Emagging allows the generator to produce dangerous levels of gravity.
RecyclerA large crushing machine used to recycle small items inefficiently. There are lights on the side.Emagging disables vital sensors, allowing living mobs to be recycled.
Scanner gateA gate able to perform mid-depth scans on any organisms who pass under it.Emagging grants access to the maintance panel.
Anti-breach shielding projectorUsed to seal minor hull breaches.Emagging grants access to the maintance panel.
Shield wall generatorA shield generator.Emagging grants access to the controls.
SleeperAn enclosed machine used to stabilize and heal patients.Emagging scrambles the chemical injection buttons, so random chemicals get injected.
Party pod'Sleeper' units were once known for their healing properties, until a lengthy investigation revealed they were also dosing patients with deadly lead acetate. This appears to be one of those old 'sleeper' units repurposed as a 'Party Pod'. It’s probably not a good idea to use it.Emagging scrambles the chemical injection buttons, on injection theres also a chance lead acetate gets injected.
Slot machineGambling for the antisocial.Emagging rigs the machine against the player.
Power flow control consoleUsed to remotely control the flow of power to different parts of the station.Emagging grants access to the maintance panel.
Communications consoleA console used for high-priority announcements and emergencies.Emagging summons a syndicate battle cruiser.
Battle arcadeExplore vast worlds and conquer.Emagging maxes the game difficulty. Upon losing the user dies. Upon wining, the user gets a nice hat and a free bomb.
The Orion TrailLearn how our ancestors got to Orion, and have fun in the process!Emagging activates realism mode, making it so you die if you loose. The winning prize becomes a spaceship toy that overheats and blows up.
FirelockApply crowbar.Emagging opens the firelock, like an electronic crowbar.
TurretA covered turret that shoots at its enemies.Emagging causes the turret to target everything accept syndicate borgs, It also doubles the power draw.
Turret control panelUsed to control a room's automated defenses.Emagging grants access to the control panel.
Message monitor consoleUsed to monitor the crew's PDA messages, as well as request console messages.Emagging forces the connected server to re-decrypt the password, the server gets disrupted scaling with how long the password is.
E-CigaretteA classy and highly sophisticated electronic cigarette, for classy and dignified gentlemen. A warning label reads "Warning: Do not fill with flammable materials."Emagging the vape causes it to explode randomly during use.
DefibrillatorA device that delivers powerful shocks to detachable paddles that resuscitate incapacitated patients. Has a rear bracket for attachments to wall mounts and medical cyborgs.Emagging toggles the shock safety, allowing you to use the defib as a shock weapon.
Cryptographic sequencerIt's a card with a magnetic strip attached to some circuitry.Bringing multiple emags together, causes the magnets to latch on and get stuck.
Fake cryptographic sequencerIt's a card with a magnetic strip attached to some circuitry.Emagging a fake emag causes it to explode on use.
Nuclear Fission Explosive toyA plastic model of a Nuclear Fission Explosive.Emagging the toy nuke causes it to explode on wind up.
Mini-MeteorRelive the excitement of a meteor shower! SweetMeat-eor Co. is not responsible for any injuries, headaches or hearing loss caused by Mini-Meteor.Emagging causes the toy meteor to explode and violently shake the station when thrown.
IntentoFundamentally useless for all intentsive purposes.Emagging the toy causes it latch onto the users hand and attack them with different intents, when activated.
R&D ConsoleA console used to interface with R&D tools.Emagging the computer unlocks manufacturing ofillegal and security only designs.Emagging the circuit board spams general radio everytime something is researched.
Supply consoleUsed to order supplies, approve requests, and control the shuttle.Emagging the console or the circuit board unlocks blackmarket supplies and contraband.
Express supply consoleThis console allows the user to purchase a package with 1/40th of the delivery time: made possible by Nanotrasen's new "1500mm Orbital Railgun".All sales are near instantaneous - please choose carefullyEmagging the console or the circuit board unlocks blackmarket supplies and contraband. It also allows the express console to deliver drops pods anywhere on station.
Light replacerA device to automatically replace lights. Refill with broken or working light bulbs, or sheets of glass.Emagging causes replaced lights to be filled with plasma, and explode when turned on.
MegaphoneA device used to project your voice. Loudly.Emagging overloads the amplifier, making the megaphone much louder.
Station intercomA trusty station intercom, ready to spring into action even when the headsets go silent.Emagging removes any radio frequency restrictions if any are in place.
Cookie SynthesizerA self-recharging device used to rapidly deploy cookies.Emagging enables or disables the creation of poisoned cookies (chloral hydrate).
Sonic Harm Prevention ToolReleases a harmless blast that confuses most organics. For when the harm is JUST TOO MUCH.Emagging toggles the amplifier on or off. If the amplifies is on, the siren is loud enough to deafen people.
LockboxA locked box.Emagging Destroys the lockbox lock.
Vend-a-trayA display case with an ID-card swiper. Use your ID to purchase the contents.Emagging the case destroys the paylock, allowing you to steal the item.
MorgueUsed to keep bodies in until someone fetches them. Includes a high-tech alert system.Emagging the morgue shorts the indicator lights, so it only displays brain dead or off.
Toilet bongA repurposed toilet with re-arranged piping and an attached flamethrower. Why would anyone build this?Emagging the bong, clogs it breaking the bong and getting your emag card wet.
AURUMILL-Brand MkII. Personnel Training MachineUsed for combat training simulations. Accepts standard training targets. A pair of buckling straps are attached.Emagging the trainer overrides the machine's safety protocols, and activates realistic combat mode. A toolbox will pop out of a slot on the top.
ClosetIt's a basic storage unit.Emagging shorts the lock on the closet if there is one.
Air alarmA machine that monitors atmosphere levels. Goes off if the area is dangerous.Emagging grants access to the maintance panel.
Quantum serverA hulking computational machine designed to fabricate virtual domains.Emagging the server doubles the chance for glitches to spawn (dangerous bitrunning anomolies).
Security gas maskA standard issue Security gas mask with integrated 'Compli-o-nator 3000' device. Plays over a dozen pre-recorded compliance phrases designed to get scumbags to stand still whilst you tase them. Do not tamper with the device.Emagging the hailer fries the safety circuit, causing the mask to spew profanity.
Space SuitA lightweight space suit with the basic ability to protect the wearer from the vacuum of space during emergencies.Emagging overides the thermal regulator thresholds, allowing the user to both cook and freeze the occupant.
Experimental Destructive ScannerA much larger version of the hand-held scanner, a charred label warns about its destructive capabilities.Emagging shorts the vital sensor allowing for living mobs to be deconstructed.
Fishing spot capsuleAn illegally modified mining capsule containing a small fishing spot connected to some faraway place.Emagging disables the fishing safety setup, allowing you to select unsafe fishing spots, like lava or plasma.
Fish-porter 3000Fishing anywhere, anytime... anyway what was I talking about?Emagging the fish portal unlocks the syndicate dimension, where you can catch dangerous things, like a chainsaw fish.
Holodeck control consoleA computer used to control a nearby holodeck.Emagging allows the loading of unsafe programs, and increases the projector power, allowing holograms to exit the room
Library visitor consoleChecked out books MUST be returned on time.Emagging unlocks forbidden knowledge, reading the forbidden knowledge may have adverse affects on the user.
Abandoned crateWhat could be inside?Emagging the crate activates the antitampor lock causing it to explode.
Grapple gunA small specialised airgun capable of launching a climbing hook into a distant rock face and pulling the user toward it via motorised zip-line. A handy tool for traversing the craggy landscape of lavaland!Emagging shorts the pressure sensor allowing the grapple gun to be used indoors
Point claim consoleA stacking console with an electromagnetic writer, used to track ore mined by prisoners.Emagging the console shorts the point tally system, allowing prisoners to go back to station.
BotA generic robot typeEmagging a silicon unlocks its cover, which can then be pried off and emagged again to change the behavior. See specific silicon entries for how the behaviors change.
CleanbotA little cleaning robot, he looks so excited!Emagging the cleanbot causes it to clean witgh slippery acid foam, and say some friendly things about dirt. It also makes any weapon attatched slightly stronger.
HonkbotA little robot. It looks happy with its bike horn.Emagging causes it to play disturbing noises and HONK people. If attacked, it will HONK the offender into oblivion.
HygienebotA flying cleaning robot, he'll chase down people who can't shower properly!Emagging the hygienebot causes it to disinfect with fire instead of soapy water.
MedibotA little medical robot. He looks somewhat underwhelmed.Emagging the bot causes it to inject people with chloral hydrate and damage instead of heal.
RepairbotI can fix it!If Emagged the bot will deconstruct floors into open space.
BotA usually powerful and potent self contained ai that runs the station.Emags the AI making it loyal to you.
Mule BotA generic robot typeDisables the crush sensors allowing the mule bot to run over living mobs.
SecuritronA generic robot typeEmagging makes the secbot arrest anything that moves, a serious crime.
FirebotA little fire extinguishing bot. He looks rather anxious.Emagging the bot changes its behavior to extinguish fire and on-fire-people with more fire. It also gives controversial fire safety advice.
